time_semantics.a0_after_common_interval: continue the same zero-input forced-path implementation to t_acquisition+0.08_s

run_order.algorithm: within each lane keep A0_PRE first and A0_POST last; order A1 by ascending SHA256('20260824|'+lane_id+'|A1|'+case_id); after all A1, order four A2 slots by the same keyed-SHA rule with arm A2

command.base_profile: Q_i=alpha_i*sigma_i*Q_ref*sin(pi*(t-start_i)/T_cmd)^2 on the closed support and exact 0.0 outside
command.profile_endpoint_implementation: return exact 0.0 at and outside both endpoints; do not rely on floating sin(pi)

active_state_and_stages.sign_rule: both centered perturbations must remain in-domain; each raw diagonal gap derivative must be strictly positive; and sigma consumed by the actual command path must equal both recomputed sign and registered sign +1 on each side; zero, negative, consumed-sign mismatch, cross-side mismatch or out-of-domain fails closed
active_state_and_stages.stage_domain_exit_action: terminate that case as DIAGNOSTIC_FAIL_CLOSED_GEOMETRY_DOMAIN without clipping or extrapolation; preserve raw pre-failure stages; exclude case from selector

work_and_ledger_audit.independent_sample_quadrature: composite trapezoid on saved P_act samples at native step plus the same rule on every second sample
work_and_ledger_audit.quadrature_acceptance: fine absolute error versus augmented W must be <=1e-7_J AND either fine error <= coarse error+1e-15_J or coarse error <=1e-7_J

event_and_hybrid.clearance_algorithm: inherit B4E piecewise cubic-Hermite all-root partition earliest bilateral dwell
event_and_hybrid.propagation_policy: evaluate earliest certified event incrementally and stop attached execution at exact removal; do not let a counterfactual post-removal attached trajectory create a geometry failure
event_and_hybrid.exact_event_reconstruction: reintegrate the forced 30D RHS from the accepted left bracket to t_removal; nearest-sample rounding forbidden
event_and_hybrid.removal_mapping: z_before=L(q_r)eta_r; z_after componentwise copy; zero impulse; zero ideal constraint stored energy
event_and_hybrid.post_release: execute a B4G-instrumented independent 29D service plus 13D target zero-external 5ms path with contact and command disabled, and cross-check its initial mapping and terminal result against the hash-bound B4E primitive
event_and_hybrid.post_release_stage_audit: at every RK4/midpoint RHS stage, stored sample and exact terminal state recheck finite state, both P coordinates in [0,0.0715]m, centered raw gap-Jacobian perturbations in-domain and both opening signs positive; no clipping or extrapolation
event_and_hybrid.post_release_work: carry W_act(t_removal) as a constant; never reset or return B3/switch dissipation

B4F-G08-COMMAND-ZERO-BEFORE-REMOVAL.scope: EVERY_EXECUTED_CASE; A0 MUST BE ZERO THROUGHOUT; FORCED CASES MUST BE ZERO OUTSIDE SUPPORT AND THROUGH ANY DWELL/REMOVAL

B4F-G09-CONTINUOUS-BILATERAL-CLEARANCE.scope: EVERY_EXECUTED CASE AS AN OUTCOME GATE

B4F-G10-EXACT-ZERO-JUMP-REMOVAL.scope: ONLY CASES WITH A CERTIFIED FINITE REMOVAL EVENT

B4F-G11-INDEPENDENT-POST-RELEASE-5MS.scope: ONLY CASES WITH A CERTIFIED FINITE REMOVAL EVENT

B4F-G12-CROSS-INTEGRATOR-CONVERGENCE.scope: EACH OF 18 A1 LEVELS ACROSS RK4_REFERENCE AND MIDPOINT_REFERENCE ONLY

B4F-G13-A2-MIRROR-AND-BILATERAL-LOGIC.scope: EXACTLY_TWO MIRROR-PAIR RECORDS PER EACH OF SIX LANES PLUS ONE GLOBAL A2 RECORD

B4F-G16-SYNTHETIC-GEOMETRY-DOMAIN.domain_exit_recording: evaluation PASS for fail-closed detector, scientific_predicate false, case excluded

reference_eligibility.event_provenance_required: each acquisition and removal time must carry its own lane-specific fresh-event source record and earliest-event certificate hash; numeric agreement alone is insufficient and forced/shared provenance fails G12
reference_eligibility.one_reference_success_only: level not eligible; cross-reference scientific predicate false
reference_eligibility.neither_reference_success: level not eligible; G12 reason NO_PAIRED_FINITE_REFERENCE_EVENT
reference_eligibility.coarse_and_fine_lanes: verification support only; never hardware replicates and never replace reference eligibility

a2_and_mirror.parent_selection: among reference-eligible A1 levels, ascending alpha then ascending T_cmd then canonical level_id
a2_and_mirror.no_parent_action: write all 24 A2 slots as NOT_EVALUATED_NO_A1_SUCCESS
a2_and_mirror.comparison: direct raw left-right swap on the common acquisition-relative active sample interval; no baseline correction, recentering, fitted offset or post-hoc symmetry transform
a2_and_mirror.gap_residual_m: max over common samples and both sides of abs(g_left_variant_R-g_right_variant_L) and converse
a2_and_mirror.gap_rate_residual_m_s: same direct swapped maximum for gap rate
a2_and_mirror.work_residual_J: absolute signed-work difference at the end of the common interval
a2_and_mirror.different_time_grid: compare only exact common acquisition-relative sample times; missing grid points or outcome mismatch makes the scientific mirror predicate false

selector.eligible_pool: A1 levels passing both reference reachability, post-release, integrity, geometry and cross-reference checks
